description: This Java class 'ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService' resides within the Fineract project and handles validation of external event configurations across tenants. It implements Spring's 'InitializingBean' to perform validation after bean properties are set, ensuring external event configurations are consistent with available event classes. The class scans for event classes implementing 'BusinessEvent' (excluding certain interfaces), retrieves configurations from a database for each tenant, and throws exceptions if discrepancies are found.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for validating external event configurations for tenants in the Fineract platform. Implements Spring's InitializingBean to trigger validation after properties are set, scans for event classes, compares configured types with available classes, and ensures consistency.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Lifecycle method called after bean properties are set; initiates validation for all tenants.

methods.name: validateEventConfigurationForAllTenants
methods.description: Validates external event configurations for all tenants by fetching all event classes and each tenant, then validating their configurations.

methods.name: validateEventConfigurationForIndividualTenant
methods.description: Validates event configurations for a specific tenant by comparing available event classes with the tenant's configured event types, throws exception if inconsistency.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurationsForTenant
methods.description: Fetches configured external event types for a specific tenant from the database.

methods.name: getAllEventClasses
methods.description: Scans source packages to find all classes implementing 'BusinessEvent' (excluding certain interfaces and abstract classes), returns their class names.
